comment: Independent C runtime path for apply.c:fig_transform through an inventory-held cursed figurine. The same independently chosen wizard setup as the preserved A61 blocked attempt gives a 10,000-turn invulnerability timeout through #wizintrinsic (the first property in timeout.c:propertynames) and wishes a cursed figurine of a little dog. C records rnd(9000)=3558 in timeout.c:attach_fig_transform_timeout, so start_timer receives 3,758 turns; the final 4,000-repeat wait covers the callback plus 242 turns while the source-granted invulnerability remains active. Inputs were extended from the C-observed timer draw, before JavaScript comparison, to reach the source timeout entry.
